title: Crestline Fleet Account Roster Maintenance
content:
The fleet manager keeps the roster of a Crestline Fleet Account current: vehicles are enrolled so drivers can charge work on them, and removed when they are sold, retired or moved to another account.

## Rules in force

- **Enrollment needs an active account.** The account must be in status active when a vehicle is enrolled. The status is read from the account record before the enrollment; it is the status of the account the vehicle is being enrolled on.
- **Removals in any status.** Removals are accepted in any status.
- **Effective date.** Changes take effect on the date given.
- **Program range.** A roster that grows above the program's most vehicles or falls below its fewest vehicles does not change the program immediately; the program is reviewed at the next credit review.
- **Open invoices stay.** Removing a vehicle does not cancel open invoices for work already done on it.

## Roster size

The roster size on a given date is the count of vehicles whose latest roster entry on the account, dated on or before that date, is an enrollment.

## Status table

| Account status | Enroll a vehicle | Remove a vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| active | allowed | allowed |
| credit hold | not allowed | allowed |
| applied | not allowed | allowed |
| closed | not allowed | allowed |
| declined | not allowed | allowed |

## Hypothetical illustration

A van enrolled on the 2nd and removed on the 20th of a month counts toward the roster on the 2nd through the 19th; from the 20th its latest entry is a removal, so it no longer counts. An invoice posted on the 12th for its brake work remains open after the removal.
